items.title: What does a missed check-in actually cost, in dollars?
items.description: The CI-vendor incident's real cost was a cancellation fee on a contract signed before the manager could weigh in. A single named check-in point (before signing) reduces that risk to zero — the research and decision quality don't have to change at all. Adjust the contract value and cancellation fee to see the actual dollar stakes of skipping that one check-in.

params.name: annualContractValue
params.label: Annual value of the contract being decided

params.name: cancellationFeePercent
params.label: Cancellation fee, as % of contract value
